outcome.technical: Verified the carried P152.23-6jb work already applied to tools/reach-diff.py and CONTRIBUTING.md against the four findings; nothing was missing, so no edit was made. R19: the hook reads REACH_DIFF_BLOCK once at install (`block = os.environ.get(...)` in _reach_diff_install) and both the start marker and the exit dump write that captured value; case rd49 runs a process that rewrites the label before exit and asserts it is filed under 'installed'. Mutation (dump reads the env at exit) -> rd49 red, 60/61. R32: _recheck_refusal compares, per block, the multisets silent_by_block, untraced and written_by_block (RECHECK_PROCESSES) by equality, so more or fewer writers refuse (recheck-processes), and compares case ids (else the case count) for recheck-cases. The refusal contract lives once in the module docstring (printed by --help), REFUSALS is parsed from it, _refuse raises ValueError on a name it does not hold, rd62 holds every named refusal to an asserting case and back, rd63 holds the raise; CONTRIBUTING.md's entry now points at --help and repeats none of it. Mutations: case-id comparison off -> rd46, rd59 red; writers compared one direction only -> rd38, rd58 red; written_by_block dropped from the comparison -> rd44, rd45, rd58 red; an extra docstring refusal with no case -> rd62 red; _refuse accepting any name -> rd63 red. R33: a change confined to non-deciding files is measured (same_side returns why only for identical bytes/commits/trees); compare refuses no-conversion only when result code is 0 and no differing file decides, so a loss exits 1. Mutations: refuse whenever nothing decides -> rd50 red; non-deciding change treated as the same side -> rd42, rd50, rd51, rd62 red. R34: ident() keeps an absolute path outside the export root and the temp/home scratch dirs verbatim (falls back to the original arg, no longer '<path>'), so children differing only in such a path are two keys. Mutation (collapse to '<path>') -> rd47, rd48 red. Gate run: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/reach-diff.py tools/_suite.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__refs.py -> exit 0, 5/5 files ok, reach-diff 61 cases. git diff of added lines grepped for register ids: none (grep exit 1). Dependants: CONTRIBUTING.md (names reach-diff by path) still correct - it points at `tools/reach-diff.py --help`, which main() answers with the docstring; test__refs.py's hook_line is a local fixture parameter, not this module's function, unaffected (suite green); parse_args/total/compare in other files are same-name functions in other modules, unaffected.
